findings.description: The condition `all(arg.help is not None ...)` contradicts the docstring ("if at least one is documented") and should be `any`. With `all`, a command with a mix of documented and undocumented arguments shows no arguments section. A command with no arguments passes `all([])` and gets an empty "Positional arguments" section.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments where only one has help. `all` returns False, so the section is skipped and the documented argument's help disappears from the output. Trigger 2: a command with zero arguments. `all` on an empty list returns True, so the code writes a section header with an empty list.
